execution.mode: production Chrome stream-copy conversion with independent native FFmpeg and FFprobe validation
execution.crossDestinationCommand: WITHIN_TEST_VIDEO=off npx playwright test tests/browser/media-remux.spec.ts --grep 'with bounded (MPEG-TS|3GP|MOV|FLV)' --reporter=line
execution.matroskaAndComplexCommand: WITHIN_TEST_VIDEO=off npx playwright test tests/browser/media-remux.spec.ts --grep 'with bounded Matroska|complex representable fields' --reporter=line

conditionalSourceFields: explicit color range, space, transfer, and primaries
audio sample rate and channel count
stream and container titles where representable
payloadAssertions: decoded video matches the source for every route
AAC access units or ISO-BMFF AAC packets match the source
non-AAC Matroska audio packets match the source
FLV H.264 packets match the source

destinationPolicies.matroska: Copies every asserted field represented by the source and both compatible streams.
destinationPolicies.mpegTs: Copies compatible language tags and explicit H.264 color fields; default dispositions, rotation, general metadata, chapters, attachments, and unsupported subtitles are disclosed exclusions.
destinationPolicies.threeGp: Copies representable ISO-BMFF fields; the muxer necessarily marks the first compatible video or audio track as default when that media type has no source default, and the worker now discloses that mapping.
destinationPolicies.mov: Copies representable ISO-BMFF fields and supported titles; the muxer necessarily marks the first compatible video or audio track as default when that media type has no source default, and the worker now discloses that mapping.
destinationPolicies.flv: Copies compatible H.264 color fields and supported title metadata; language, disposition, rotation, chapters, attachments, unsupported subtitles, and additional audio are disclosed exclusions.

nativeAudit.simpleH264TraceHeaders: No VUI color-description or full-range flags are present; FFprobe's tv range is therefore an implicit H.264 limited-range interpretation rather than an explicit source declaration.
nativeAudit.complexH264TraceHeaders: The complex fixture explicitly carries video_full_range_flag=0 and BT.709 primaries, transfer, and matrix values, all of which remain asserted at compatible destinations.
nativeAudit.nativeContainerCopies: Native FFmpeg copies of the simple Matroska fixture to MPEG-TS, 3GP, MOV, and FLV likewise reported no explicit color fields.
nativeAudit.nativeIsoBmffDisposition: Native FFmpeg still marks the first video and audio streams default in 3GP and MOV after explicit source-side default dispositions are cleared.

diagnosticHistory.attempt: first 20-route destination matrix before wrapper rebuild
diagnosticHistory.details: Four failures were validator false positives caused by treating implicit H.264 limited range as explicit metadata. Four exposed the genuine, previously undisclosed 3GP/MOV forced-default mapping for MPEG-TS and FLV sources.

diagnosticHistory.result: confirmed implicit-color semantics and unavoidable first-track default behavior
diagnosticHistory.resolution: The validator now requires only explicitly declared color fields, while the native wrapper and public registry disclose the forced-default mapping.

hostedNoDockerReproduction.candidateResult: expected mismatch: only within-remux.wasm differed; every companion artifact was byte-exact
hostedNoDockerReproduction.publicationResult: success: every FFmpeg artifact rebuilt byte-exact

scope: This proves representable field and compressed-payload behavior for the 28 currently compatible source/destination pairs in the focused matrix. M-03 remains partial: equally complex MOV, 3GP, MPEG-TS, FLV, AVI, WebM, and Ogg-origin fixtures plus attached-picture dispositions are not yet completely covered.
